subject: ScoutAI — onboarding credit plan & commit tiering
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@scoutai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: ScoutAI: onboarding credit ask + topline commit options

Hi Anika — great to meet yesterday. As discussed, ScoutAI’s use case (real-time summarization + customer-facing chat) looks like a solid fit for our Hosted API. To make procurement and the pilot move quickly, I want to propose a simple onboarding credit + commit structure so your procurement/finance teams can map spend to outcomes.

Topline ask from ScoutAI we heard:
- 90-day POC to validate latency and hallucination rate on production prompts
- Clear per-token unit pricing for expected peak and steady-state volumes
- Some upfront credits or launch incentives tied to a minimum commit to reduce initial risk

Attached: scoutai_MVP_specs.pdf (brief) — helps us size the expected token profile.

Proposed starter options (we can iterate):
1) Minimal pilot (no commit):
   - 30k free tokens (onboarding credits) for 30 days
   - Standard hosted rates (no discount) thereafter
2) Small commit (3-month committed spend):
   - $5k/month committed (billed monthly)
   - 75k onboarding tokens up front + additional 25k unlock on demo completion
   - Per-token discount: 7% off base hosted rate for committed usage
3) Launch/Seed commit (6-month):
   - $20k/month commit (prepay or monthly)
   - 200k onboarding tokens, 50% of which are free-credit, rest burnable against usage
   - Per-token discount: 15% off base hosted rate; milestone-based bonus credits at customer adoption thresholds

Questions for you to help us finalize:
- Which commit horizon maps to ScoutAI’s procurement tolerance (3 vs 6 months)?
- Do you prefer credits as token units or a dollar credit that can apply to any metered usage?
- Any compliance/PO language procurement requires up front?

If this looks reasonable, Ben (cc’d) will draft a short term sheet and we can get you a DocuSign for legal. Happy to jump on a 30-min call with procurement tomorrow if that speeds things up.

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scoutai_MVP_specs.pdf (PDF)

From: Anika Shah <anika@scoutai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Silva <marco@scoutai.com>, ScoutAI Procurement <procurement@scoutai.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ScoutAI: onboarding credit ask + topline commit options

Thanks, Evelyn — this is helpful and a good starting point. A few quick clarifications from our side:
- Procurement is leaning toward a 3-month commit for the POC stage; finance prefers shorter horizons for new vendors.
- We have a preference for credits represented as a dollar credit (easier to reconcile vs tokens).
- Procurement will want standard SLAs and an out clause after the initial POC, and Marco (cc) handles the legal checklist.

Next steps: can you provide an example price sheet with concrete per-token price points (base and discounted) and show how credits apply as dollar offsets? Also please include any minimums that would trigger an automatic transition off the pilot pricing.

I can do a 30-min call tomorrow 11am PT with Marco and procurement if that works for you/Ben.

—Anika
VP, Product
ScoutAI

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 13:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: ScoutAI: onboarding credit ask + topline commit options — draft price matrix

Evelyn / Rishi — I put together a quick draft matrix (attached) that converts tokens to dollar credits and shows per-token rates at a few commit levels. Notes:
- Base hosted rate (example): $0.00035 / token for context-free generation.
- Suggested per-token pricing after discounts:
   * No commit: $0.00035
   * 3-month commit ($5k/mo): $0.000325 (7% off)
   * 6-month commit ($20k/mo): $0.000298 (15% off)
- Onboarding credits: convert tokens to a dollar credit using the base rate for transparency (e.g., 75k tokens ~ $26.25 at base). For finance this is cleaner.
- Milestone unlocks: Recommend we split onboarding credit into 50% upfront, 50% unlocked on (a) successful integration demo, (b) 30-day active usage threshold.
- Auto-burn policy: unused credits expire 120 days after issue unless a longer period is negotiated for enterprise deals.

Attached: redwood_commit_matrix_v1.xlsx — this has examples tied to ScoutAI expected monthly token profile from the spec.

If procurement wants dollar credits + a 3-month commit, our ask would be: $15k commit (3 months x $5k) with 75% of onboarding credit applied as dollar credit, and a simple SLA for uptime and data controls. That should be acceptable for both sides and keeps legal simple.

I’ll be on the call at 11am PT.

Cheers,
Ben
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_commit_matrix_v1.xlsx (Excel)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: ScoutAI: onboarding credit ask + topline commit options — legal / ops notes

Quick comments from a pricing / ops perspective:
- Prefer dollar-denominated credits (agree with Ben) — avoids token-type ambiguity across models / multi-model routing.
- Suggest we add a cap to how much of the onboarding credit can be used for non-production dev environments (we should preserve credits for production validation). Example: max 30% for dev/test.
- For the 3-month commit proposal, convert the onboarding credit into a non-refundable credit that applies to monthly invoices until exhausted — if customer terminates early, remaining credits are void.
- Recommend we keep expiry at 120 days but allow negotiation to 180 days for strategic or enterprise deals.
- Request legal to include a short clause that credits do not constitute a guarantee of service and are purely billing offsets.

Lauren — looping you for any compliance headwinds on the SLA or data residency asks from ScoutAI (they said US-only data center is preferable).

—Rishi
Head of Pricing & Offers
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@scoutai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Finalized: 3-month commit offer + onboarding credit breakdown

Hi Anika / Marco / Procurement team — thanks for the call earlier. Per our conversation, here’s the offer we’ll put into a short term sheet so procurement/legal can review:

Offer: 3-month POC commit
- Commit: $5,000 / month for 3 months (total committed $15,000)
- Pricing: per-token list rate $0.00035; committed rate $0.000325 (7% discount) applied to usage that counts against the commit
- Onboarding credit: $2,500 dollar credit at signing (represents ~75k tokens at list rate)
   * 60% of the credit ($1,500) applied immediately to first invoices
   * 40% ($1,000) unlocked on a successful integration demo and 30 days of active production usage
   * Max 30% of the credit may be applied to non-production/dev usage
- Credit expiry: 120 days from issuance (negotiable to 180 days with enterprise approval)
- Early termination: remaining unused credits void; standard termination language applies
- SLA & Data: US region hosting available; standard 99.9% uptime SLA for hosted API included in term sheet

Next steps:
1) We’ll send a short term sheet via DocuSign (link below) — please review and confirm who will sign on ScoutAI’s side.
2) Ben will set up a technical check-in tomorrow to confirm integration milestones for the demo.
3) Rishi/Legal will draft the credit clause language for procurement review.

DocuSign (preview): https://docusign.net/Signing/?tn=SCOUTAI-TS-041
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If this aligns with your expectations, we’ll issue the term sheet and the $2,500 credit immediately on signature.

Thanks — looking forward to getting ScoutAI onboarded.

Best,
Evelyn
Head of Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: docusign_scoutai_term_sheet.pdf (PDF)
